# People Atlas 0.3.1

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **Compatibility: People Atlas 0.3.1 only supports Obsidian 1.13.0 or newer. Obsidian 1.12.x and older are not supported.**

This maintenance release updates the development, CI, and release toolchain.

## Changes

- Raised the declared project and GitHub Actions build runtime from Node.js 22
  to Node.js 24 LTS.
- Upgraded `actions/checkout` and `actions/setup-node` from v4 to v7 so both
  workflows use the supported Node.js 24 action runtime.
- Updated the active release and performance contracts, documentation, and
  performance metadata to match the Node.js 24 baseline.

There are no plugin-behavior or vault-data changes in this release.

## Assets

Install or update the plugin with the attached `main.js`, `manifest.json`, and
`styles.css`.
